parrafo_1.es: Mr Taco USA es un negocio local de comida mexicana en Lakeland, FL. Tacos de birria, sopes y hot dogs estilo mexicano, servidos frescos y con las guarniciones de siempre: cebolla, cilantro y limon.
parrafo_1.en: Mr Taco USA is a local Mexican food spot in Lakeland, FL. Birria tacos, sopes and Mexican-style hot dogs, served fresh with the classic sides: onion, cilantro and lime.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes que vuelven semana tras semana describen el lugar como la autenticidad real de Lakeland, con precios justos y buen servicio.
parrafo_2.en: Customers who come back week after week describe it as real authenticity in Lakeland, with fair prices and good service.

items.quote: Best food in town, my personal favorite is the quesa birria tacos, but honestly every item on the menu is delicious. Also sopes and the hotdogs with sausage and bacon are really good.
Authenticity right here in Lakeland. Absolutely delicious and highly recommend fair pricing for quality of food.
Best tacos in town and one of the best taco spots I've been to! I always stop here for lunch. Great service every time!
First, the food was fantastic! The tacos I had were flavorful, fresh and tasty. Second the prices were super reasonable. And third the atmosphere was really cool. Definitely going back.
